simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to פּוּשׁ (H6335) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 5 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: פּוּשׁ (pûwsh) means to spread ; figuratively, act proudly First listed occurrence: Hab 1 8.

definitions.usage: grow up, be grown fat, spread selves, be scattered.
definitions.full: H6335. puwsh I. [ מּוּשׁ ] verb apparently spring about , Qal Perfect 3plural consecutive מָּרָשָׁיו וּפָשׁוּ Hab 1:8 (but probably strike out וּפָשׁוּ as dittograph see Now); 2 masculine plural consecutive וּפִשְׁתֶּם Malachi 3:20, Imperfect 2masculine plural תָּפוּשׁוּ Jer 50:11 Qr (so ᵐ5 ; > Kt תפושׁי ), in both, simile of gambolling calves. II. [ מּוּשׁ ] verb Niph`al be scattered ; — 3 plural עַלהֶֿהָרִים עַמְּךָ נָפ֫שׁוּ Nahum 3:18 (read probably נָפֹצוּ ).
